summary: The file profiler names the signature bootstrap's pages and the publication evidence loop, so their statements no longer show as (unlabeled tokio-rt-worker)

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery change.

schema.detail: No table, index, trigger or schema version change.

rules.detail: No claim or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: Only profiling and task-metric output changes. With ST3_PROFILE_DIR set, the signature bootstrap's work and the publication evidence loop's work show under their task names instead of (unlabeled tokio-rt-worker). Nothing else is renamed. With task metrics on, the bootstrap's pages are measured under five new maintenance.signature_bootstrap_* task names, three of which are new writer origins. With task metrics off, these loops also enter the in-process performance meter under those names, as other profiled_blocking loops already do. Behaviour does not change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs before the daemon serves.

recovery.detail: Rolling back is safe: the previous release leaves the same work unlabeled.
